{{Top}}
[[File:Leianecklace.jpg|200px|thumb|Organa's Ceremonial Necklace]]
A '''necklace''' was a type of jewelry. They where sometimes sold at street side stalls. Different types of necklaces could be silver, made of [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and/or have stones in them. Some necklaces, such as [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace|necklace]], could also be artifacts. They were often worn by royalty, like [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] and [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]].
